sections: A practical approach

I care about preserving a way back, avoiding unnecessary lock-in and protecting the core when something fails. Technology, operations and creativity all begin with context, clear questions and room to adjust.

This site introduces my approach, areas of work and direct contact details. For maritime Internet and onboard technology inquiries, visit DUNCAN SYSTEM LLC.

principles.title: Principles
principles.description: I design around controlled loss and recovery, rather than trying to preserve everything at any cost.

A system needs

principles.lead: I design around controlled loss and recovery, rather than trying to preserve everything at any cost.
principles.quote: Security should protect access without locking out the person it serves.
sections: ROOT
The foundation to protect. Without it, the system cannot continue.
CORE
The essential operating parts. Losing them stops the system.
BRANCH
Useful extensions. The system can continue without them.
LEAF
Presentation and decoration. Let them go when necessary.
principles.closing: When a trade-off is unavoidable, protect ROOT and CORE first.
